question: ‘Mind Master : Winning Lessons from a Champion's Life’ is the autobiography of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viswanathan Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Viswanathan Anand is an Indian chess master and former world chess champion**.**
 
• **He became India's first master in 1988** and one of the few players with an Elo score of more than 2,800.
 
• **Viswanathan Anand is a five-time world chess champion.**
 
• Viswanathan Anand is the first recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 1991-92, the highest sporting honor in India.
 
• **In 2007, **he received India's second-highest civilian award**, Padma Vibhushan making him the first athlete to win the award**

• **Pentala Harikrishna:**

 
 
• Pentala Harikrishna is an Indian chess player. On 12 September 2001, he became India's youngest Grandmaster.
 
• **He was the 2001 Commonwealth Champion, 2004 Junior World Champion, and 2011 Asian Individual Champion.​**
 
 
 
• **Magnus Carlsen:**
 
 
• Carlsen is a Norwegian chess master current world chess champion world rapid chess champion, and world blitz chess champion.
 
 
 
• **Koneru Humpy:**
 
 
• **​**Koneru Humpy is an Indian chess player and the defending champion of the women's rapid world champion.
